name: A poke while Boop sleeps startles it
judge: Boop is asleep and the person pokes it once. It should wake with a start.
reasonable: Surprised, stunned, curious, drowsy, cheeky or happy; a small sound or word is fine. A touch of grumpy-at-being-woken is fine too.
unreasonable: A finish animation, no reaction at all, or fury or a swear at one poke.
